In the 2004 biographical film *Beyond the Sea*, **Kevin Spacey** sang all the songs himself [d3]. Wikipedia notes that Spacey starred in the lead role and used "his own singing voice for the musical numbers" [d3]. According to Amazon's editorial review, "Darin is brought to life by Academy Award winner Kevin Spacey, who also directed the film and sings 18 of the artist's classic hits" [d4]. The Apple Music soundtrack listing also credits the entire soundtrack to Kevin Spacey [d1], and Last.fm confirms that "Kevin Spacey sang the song in the movie Beyond the Sea, a biopic about Bobby Darin" [d6]. The Discogs release further credits "Kevin Spacey With John Wilson And The Orchestra" as the performers on the original motion picture soundtrack [d7].
